title: Evening 6 — the last two fronts, and the Ridda's last word. The Line is drawn once and lit checkpoint by checkpoint; nothing tonight has not yet been told is drawn.
note: Lanes are the threads of the evening, not geography. 'The war as a whole' carries the retrospective cards, which belong to no single front. Events marked 'delivered' were told on evenings 2-5 and are drawn small, so the room sees tonight's work against what it already has.

styles.lit: gold dot, ink bold label — tonight's material, told up to this checkpoint
styles.delivered: small teal dot, muted label — told on an earlier evening
styles.untold: hollow dot, muted label — 'later' only. Tonight's parts not yet told at a checkpoint are not drawn.

not_drawn.why: Tonight's parts not yet reached at a checkpoint are not drawn at all, so the Line never shows the room an event before it has been told.
